items.title: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform
items.summary: The bank is now offering institutional crypto spot trading in the region, bringing BTC and ETH onto the same eFX rails that institutions use to trade dollars and euros.

items.title: Standard Chartered launches spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in UAE
items.summary: Standard Chartered said it is the first major global bank to offer institutional access to spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE region.

items.title: Ether, XRP ETF inflow streaks end as Bitcoin funds rebound
items.summary: Ether ETFs posted $48 million in outflows after attracting $1.62 billion over 12 trading days, while XRP funds ended an 11-session inflow run.

items.title: Dogecoin becomes only losing bet for Japan-listed firm as it sells altcoins for bitcoin
items.summary: Remixpoint booked gains on ether, solana and XRP, but sold DOGE below its fiscal-year opening value as it concentrated its crypto holdings in bitcoin.
